design_description: NEGATIVE CONTROL: trastuzumab wild-type VH+VL (PDB 1N8Z chains B+A). Must FAIL de novo (100% identity).
NEGATIVE CONTROL: trastuzumab framework, CDRH3 SRWGGDGFYAMDY->SRWGGDGFYKLDY (2 substitutions). Must FAIL de novo (~99% identity).
POSITIVE CONTROL: caplacizumab VHH framework (pmvk_caplacizumab.cif entity 2) with synthetic non-caplacizumab CDR1/2/3. Must PASS de novo.
